label: Takeaway
detail: Aquinas went 25-26 overall and 17-11 in the WHAC, then lost both WHAC Tournament games on Apr 30. Its posted 2027 roster keeps 51% of 2026 plate appearances and 54% of innings, and adds 25 new names. Nguyen, the team's home run leader, is not on it, and Hysell and Robinson are.

label: Method
detail: Back means a 2026 player whose name is on Aquinas's posted 2027 roster. Everyone else who played counts as out, either as a listed senior or as not on the roster. A posted roster can still change before the season.

label: Season
detail: 25-26 was Aquinas's first losing season since 2022, after 30-23 in 2023 and 28-26 in both 2024 and 2025. Its 17-11 WHAC record is two wins behind 2025's 19-9.

label: WHAC Tournament
detail: Rockford, Apr 30: lost to Cleary 5-2 after Mitchelson went 6.2 innings, with Cleary scoring 3 in the 8th, then lost to Northwestern Ohio 10-1. The recap lists no seed.

label: Speed
detail: Aquinas stole 131 bases in 166 tries, 3rd of 12 WHAC teams per game and 32nd in the NAIA. Nguyen had 20, and Hysell and Deller 15 each.

label: Scoring
detail: Aquinas scored 5.56 runs a game in NAIA stats, 8th of 11 in the WHAC, and hit .270, also 8th.

label: Power
detail: 20 homers ranked 8th of 12 WHAC teams per game and 147th in the NAIA. Nguyen hit 8 of them.

label: Joey Hysell
detail: Hysell hit .310 with a .849 OPS, and .344 with a .922 OPS against WHAC teams. He made second-team All-WHAC and is on the 2027 roster.

label: League play
detail: Aquinas went 17-11 in the WHAC and 8-13 outside it before the tournament. It hit .279 in WHAC games with a 6.20 ERA, against .270 and 6.23 overall.

label: Free passes and strikeouts
detail: The staff allowed 6.21 walks and hit batters per nine, 3rd of 12 in the WHAC, and struck out 6.89 per nine, 9th.

label: Late innings
detail: Weide had 5 saves and a 2.61 ERA, and Mitchelson 3 saves and a 4.17 ERA. Both are listed seniors. Lubbers had the other save.

label: Catcher
detail: Shadduck (29 starts) and Hayes (17) were listed seniors and are not on the 2027 roster. Whitten made 5 starts and hit .400 in 15 at-bats. Hysell is listed as C/3B for 2027, and seven others on the roster list catcher as a position.

label: First base
detail: Weinert made all 41 of his starts here and is a listed senior who is not on the 2027 roster. Hysell made 4 starts. Nelson (Jackson College) and Kornacki are new names listed at 1B/3B.

label: Middle infield
detail: LaMange made 43 starts at second and won a WHAC Gold Glove. Gregory made 40 starts at short as a freshman. Both are on the 2027 roster.

label: Third base
detail: Hysell made 44 starts here and is on the 2027 roster.

label: Outfield
detail: Robinson made all 46 of his starts in right. Kovl made 23 in center. Nguyen (45 in left) and Bryce (23 in center) are listed seniors who are not on the 2027 roster. Moss (Milligan), Brooks (Siena Heights) and Meyers are new names listed in the outfield.

label: Designated hitter
detail: Alcumbrack made 20 starts here as a freshman. Edwards (10) is a listed senior, and Mueller (6) is not on the 2027 roster.

label: Rotation
detail: Pollack (12 starts), Bowen (10) and Russell (9) are on the 2027 roster and made 31 of the 51 starts. Moore (6) and Lubbers (6) are not, and Winans (4) is.

label: Bullpen
detail: Brockie made 14 relief outings and is on the 2027 roster. Weide, Mitchelson, Doyle and Burch made 51 relief outings and 8 of the 9 saves, and none is on it.

label: On the 2027 roster
detail: 37 players from the 2026 roster, including Hysell, Robinson, LaMange, Gregory and Kovl.

label: Listed senior hitters not on it, 10 or more at-bats
detail: Dylan Nguyen, Stephen Weinert, Kasy Shadduck, Zachary Hayes, Eric Bryce, Kaden Edwards, Austin Deller, Blake Bennett.

label: Other hitters not on it, 10 or more at-bats
detail: Brayden Monroe, Landon Mueller, Mason Ruether. Their next stop is not confirmed here.

label: Pitchers not on it, 10 or more innings
detail: Kaleb Mitchelson (36.2 IP), Hudson Lubbers (31.1 IP), Aaron Moore (31.0 IP), Hunter Doyle (21.1 IP), Travis Weide (20.2 IP), Brendan Burch (12.1 IP), Aidan Schauss (11.0 IP).

label: New names from other colleges
detail: Trey Boven (IF/P, Mid Michigan CC), Keith Brooks (OF, Siena Heights), Jansen Douma (LHP, GRCC), Ben Meyers (OF/C, Muskegon CC), Nick Moss (OF/IF, Milligan University), Nathan Murphy (RHP, KVCC), Sebastian Nelson (1B/3B, Jackson College).

label: New names from high school
detail: 18 players, listed as freshmen on the 2027 roster page. All 25 new names are on the Recruiting tab.

label: Chris LaMange, head coach
detail: 161-166 over seven seasons by Aquinas's schedule pages, including 25-26 in 2026. His bio still lists 108-114 over five seasons, which matches 2020 through 2024. He went 554-307 at East Grand Rapids and played at Aquinas.

label: Steve Wojciechowski, pitching coach
detail: Listed on the 2026 and 2027 staff pages.

label: Cody Westerhuis, assistant coach
detail: Listed on the 2026 and 2027 staff pages.

label: Pat Gillies, head JV coach
detail: Listed on the 2026 and 2027 staff pages.

label: Joey Hysell
detail: Second-team All-WHAC at third base.

label: JT LaMange
detail: WHAC Gold Glove team at second base.

label: Austin Deller
detail: WHAC Champions of Character team.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 63 of 66 list a Michigan hometown. Kent County has the most with 21, then Ottawa (5) and Muskegon (4).

label: How players arrive
detail: 55 of 66 list a high school as their previous school, 10 a community college and 1 another four-year school. The roster lists only one previous school per player.

label: Transfers in the lineup
detail: Nguyen and Hysell came from Grand Rapids CC, Weinert from Muskegon CC and Weide from Albion.

label: Rochester Christian is missing from NAIA stats
detail: The NAIA stats team table lists 11 WHAC teams, without Rochester Christian. Aquinas's WHAC ranks are out of those 11, while Cleary's column on this page was worked out earlier against 12. Side-by-side edges compare the two teams' actual numbers, not their ranks.

label: NAIA stats leaves out the Alma game
detail: Aquinas's official totals cover 51 games. NAIA stats has 50, because the Mar 24 game against Alma, an NCAA Division III school, isn't there. So the league table shows a 6.29 ERA and the official figure is 6.23. I took that one box score from Aquinas's site.

label: Hitting gaps against published stats
detail: Season lines here are the official ones; filters add up the box scores. Official then box score: Nguyen RBI 28, 30. Weinert strikeouts 21, 22 and steals 13, 12. Hysell steals 15, 16. Bryce RBI 10, 9 and steals 10, 9. Alcumbrack RBI 11, 10. Snelling RBI 1, 0. Gregory doubles 6, 5. Kovl at-bats 77, 78. LaMange at-bats 136, 137. Robinson at-bats 151, 150 and sacrifice flies 1, 2. Shadduck sacrifice flies 0, 1 and sacrifice bunts 4, 3. Weinert and Hayes double-play grounders 1, 2 and Whitten 2, 1. Team: at-bats 1,494, 1,495; strikeouts 332, 333; RBI 231, 230; doubles 73, 72; sacrifice flies 12, 14; sacrifice bunts 35, 34; steals 131, 130; double-play grounders 21, 22.

label: Pitching gaps against published stats
detail: Official then box score or play-by-play: Mitchelson hits 43, 44, earned runs 17, 18, at-bats against 141, 142 and sacrifice bunts allowed 10, 9. Hileman doubles allowed 5, 4. Pollack earned runs 34, 33. Schauss earned runs 11, 12. Bowen wild pitches 4, 5. Hileman wild pitches 1, 0. Team hits allowed 482, 483, earned runs 264, 267, at-bats against 1,557, 1,558, doubles allowed 101, 100 and sacrifice bunts allowed 34, 33. The official pitcher lines add to 266 earned runs, 2 more than the official team total. The official game-by-game table also differs from box scores in some single games, such as 6 team earned runs in the Apr 23 loss to Cleary against 4 in the box score, so game log errors and strikeouts follow the box score.

label: Pitcher decisions are incomplete by game
detail: Many box scores list no win, loss or save beside a pitcher. Season totals here are published ones, so the Decision column in the outing log and filtered win totals can run short.

label: Most games have no real counts
detail: 31 of the 51 box scores have no usable counts: 24 list every count as 0-0 and 7 list none. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats. Counts appear for about 40% of plate appearances and full pitch sequences for about 34%.

label: Bats and throws are mostly missing
detail: Only 10 of 66 players have bats and throws on the 2026 roster, so pull and opposite-field shares are blank for hitters without them.

label: Roster page typos and blanks
detail: Hometowns are shown as listed, with "Mukegona" read as Muskegon. Several players have no position on the 2026 roster, so I used the 2027 roster where it had one. Winans's position is listed as "LPH" and I read that as LHP.

label: 2027 roster is a posted page, not a final one
detail: It lists 62 players, and Winans appears as a senior both years. The projections here use it as posted.

label: Coach record
detail: LaMange's bio stops at 108-114. Adding the schedule pages for 2020 through 2026 gives 161-166, which is what this page uses.

label: Older seasons left off the wins chart
detail: Schedule pages from 2014 and earlier show records with a third number, such as 25-20-18, that doesn't look like ties, so the chart starts at 2015.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and the posted roster. Aquinas has published no depth chart. New names have no 2026 Aquinas stats, so none is in a projected spot.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from Aquinas's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate, and Gull Lake is placed at the lake. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Cancelled game
detail: Aquinas's schedule shows a Mar 5 game against Daytona Beach Christian with no result. It isn't counted.

label: Commits
detail: No commit list for Aquinas was found. On Nov 4 an X search for commits found nothing current. The Recruiting tab lists the 25 new names from the 2027 roster page instead.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The game log adds to 25-26, 280 runs scored and 317 allowed, and to 17-11 in WHAC games. Line scores match those run totals.

label: Starts in the hitter table
detail: Russell's 9 starts and Weide's 1 in the hitter table are pitching starts carried in Aquinas's official batting table. Neither started in the batting order in those games.

label: Older Cleary meetings
detail: Aquinas's history page goes back to 2015. The Vs Cleary tab starts at 2019 to match the other teams, which leaves off 8 games.

label: WHAC site
detail: whac.net refused my browser for its stats page, so I read the honors release through search access and team totals from NAIA stats.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players on the posted 2027 roster with a 2026 Aquinas record. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Six of the nine made at least 20 starts at that position. Whitten made 5 at catcher, Bozek made 1 in left, and Bousseau made none at first. Hysell (4) and LaMange (2) started at first but are placed at their main positions.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 51 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at DH (Alcumbrack, 20) or center (Kovl, 23), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: Aquinas used 50 different lineups in 51 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles from the posted roster. Moore and Lubbers made 12 starts between them and aren't on it, so Winans fills the fourth spot with his 4 starts. New names have no 2026 stats here.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: Each of the 66 players with a listed hometown is plotted at that hometown. The hot zone is a density estimate over those towns, so color shows concentration, not exact locations.

label: League
detail: Aquinas ranked 3rd of 12 WHAC teams in steals per game and 4th in walk rate, but 9th in OPS. On the mound it ranked 3rd in walks and hit batters per nine, 6th in ERA and 9th in strikeouts per nine.

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. Aquinas's numbers are from NAIA stats, which has 50 of its 51 games, and its WHAC rank is out of 11 teams because Rochester Christian isn't listed.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows Aquinas's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: D1Baseball season preview
detail: Conference previews plus a Top 25 table with rank, last record and last final rank.
extra: Overview: last season and preseason context up front

label: Baseball America newcomer classes
detail: Each team lists transfers and high school recruits by tier, then explains fit.
extra: Recruiting tab: newcomers by route, with fit notes

label: Black College Nines team previews
detail: Returning starters, starting pitching, relievers and newcomers with prior school, then a short outlook.

label: College football returning production
detail: A weighted share of last year's production that returns, with transfers added in.
extra: Returning share bars, unweighted for now

label: EvanMiya college basketball
detail: Share of minutes from returners. Returner-reliant teams beat expectations far more often than newcomer-reliant ones.
extra: Plate appearances and innings as the continuity measure

label: TeamRankings college basketball
detail: Projects from prior ratings, returning production, recruits, transfers and coaching changes.
extra: Staff tab: coaching change treated as an input

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Runs by inning
detail: Aquinas scored most in the 3rd (47 runs) and 5th (44), and 17 in the 1st. It scored 68 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 6th, 52 runs, then 46 in the 4th.

label: Steals
detail: Play-by-play shows 105 steals of second, 19 of third and 6 of home, 130 of the 131 published. Aquinas was caught 35 times.

label: Where Aquinas has the edge
detail: Speed and free passes on the mound: 2.56 steals a game to Cleary's 1.44, and 6.21 walks and hit batters per nine to 7.29.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: Most of the hitting line: .320 batting average to .270, .886 OPS to .753, and 7.69 runs a game to 5.56. Cleary also has the lower ERA, 5.70 to 6.29.

label: Close
detail: Homers per game are even at 0.40.

detail: Pollack started for Aquinas (3.0 IP, 3 ER) and Seman for Cleary (5.0 IP, 1 ER). Nguyen went 1-for-3 for Aquinas, and Wesley went 3-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Apr 23: Aquinas 13, Cleary 10
detail: Russell started for Aquinas (1.0 IP, 6 ER) and Montilla for Cleary (4.0 IP, 4 ER). Nguyen went 3-for-6 for Aquinas, and Wesley went 3-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Apr 25: Cleary 11, Aquinas 3
detail: Bowen started for Aquinas (2.0 IP, 4 ER) and Lieng for Cleary (2.0 IP, 1 ER). Robinson went 2-for-3 for Aquinas, and Wesley went 2-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Apr 25: Cleary 5, Aquinas 4
detail: Lubbers started for Aquinas (0.1 IP, 3 ER) and Fay for Cleary (5.0 IP, 1 ER). Monroe went 2-for-4 for Aquinas, and Kempainen went 1-for-5 for Cleary.

label: Apr 30, WHAC Tournament: Cleary 5, Aquinas 2
detail: Mitchelson started for Aquinas (6.2 IP, 1 ER) and Seman for Cleary (7.2 IP, 1 ER). Nguyen went 3-for-5 for Aquinas, and Boone went 2-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 51 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies. That gives Aquinas's hitters 388 and 371. Scorers can classify a few plays differently.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Weinert has 1.41 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), and Robinson has 0.62.

label: How long arms go
detail: Pollack averages 4.7 innings a start, Bowen 4.1 and Russell 3.8. Doyle 1.4 and Brockie 2.3 per relief outing.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Mitchelson has 1.40 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Moore has 0.54.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, Gregory swings at the most first pitches, 42% on 74 of 145. Hysell swings at the fewest, 25% on 80 of 199.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Gregory, Robinson and Weinert whiff on 17% of swings, the fewest among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, and Nguyen on 24%. Shadduck is at 37% on 50 plate appearances with pitch data. On the mound, Brockie gets a whiff on 23% and Moore on 11%.

label: Direction
detail: Aquinas's roster lists a batting side for only a few players. I added six from Prep Baseball Report and The Baseball Cube, which gives a side for 9 of the 19 hitters here. Pull and Oppo stay blank for the rest. Among regulars with a known side, Hysell pulls 55% on 134 batted balls with a direction, and Shadduck pulls 33% on 63.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Moore averages 80 pitches over 3 starts with a count, and Lubbers averages 54 over 5. Averages use only outings with a listed count.

label: Checked against NAIA stats
detail: I compared every Aquinas game with a gap against NAIA stats, which posts the same box scores as the WHAC site, and found no more pitch data or pitch counts. Aquinas's own box scores added strikeout marks, corrected five K-looking marks and added four decisions.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 1,110 of Aquinas's 1,495 at-bats (74%): 96% of balls in play, 87% of hits (353 of 404) and 100% of everything else (757 of 758). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots. NAIA stats has no Alma game, so that play-by-play is from Aquinas's site. It leaves Robinson, LaMange and Kovl one at-bat off their official totals.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.
